answer: Each grove requires an ivory relic to establish trust, costing 10 copper coins per relic. If two groves share a relic, each grove pays 20 copper coins, and the cost increases linearly by 10 copper coins per additional grove sharing the same relic. Thus, an attacker with 100 groves sharing 10 relics incurs 2000 copper coins per relic, making mass sybil attacks prohibitively expensive, while honest groves only spend 10 copper coins each.
